raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer supplied incorrect pricing inputs by using a third-party discounted daily ticket price of $39.22 (from FunEx) instead of the correct 2024 single-day ticket benchmark ($36) for California’s Great America, and paired it with a season pass price of $89. This inflated the daily ticket total and led to an overestimated savings of $67.88 instead of the correct $55. The Orchestrator’s math was consistent with WebSurfer’s wrong inputs, so the error originated with WebSurfer’s data selection at step 14.
